notes: Parent concept with seven narrower children; judged parent-level docs and child docs across all four subdomains. Top grade to LUNG_EGFR_P23, whose entire randomized design has grade 2+ dermatologic and infusion toxicity as its primary endpoint; BREAST_CDK_P20 (drug-related interstitial lung disease), IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_G05 (mechanisms/mitigation of checkpoint toxicity), HEME_CART_G04/P07/P08 (neurotoxicity) and HEME_CART_P23 (keratopathy) are equally toxicity-centred despite never using the parent's wording. Zeros are same-drug near-misses that contain no adverse-event content.

Parent with four narrower model-type children, each confined to a different subdomain file, so the query tests hierarchical generalisation across all four. LUNG_EGFR_P08 earns 3 because the entire paper is the construction and use of an autochthonous Egfr/Rb1/Trp53 mouse with lineage tracing; BREAST_CDK_G03 and HEME_CART_G07 likewise make the model system (PDX/organoid panel; orthotopic stroma-intact implants) the object of study. Zeros are human-tissue-only studies that a model-word retriever might still surface.

All three parent-level docs (lung) are lexically silent for 'microenvironment' - they say 'immune contexture' or 'terrain'. LUNG_EGFR_P18 gets 3: 36-marker imaging mass cytometry of 204 tumours whose whole subject is the spatial immune composition. Children judged too: TAM state (IMMUNO_P05/P22), TLS (IMMUNO_P06), hypoxia/adenosine (IMMUNO_G09/P16) and immunosuppressive niche (HEME_G07/P14). BREAST_CDK_P16 is included because it measures malignant-state distance to CD8 cells and fibroblasts.

Parent with three narrower children spanning heme (flow, clonotype) and lung (molecular residual disease); breast ctDNA-MRD grants carry the concept without the parent's wording. HEME_CART_G06 is the definitive doc: its whole purpose is harmonising the two residual-disease assays and testing surrogacy. Zeros distinguish residual-disease detection from serial ctDNA used to time progression (BREAST_CDK_P06) or to predict pathologic response (IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P13).

Hierarchical: parent (lung kinase degraders) plus SERD and targeted-degradation children (breast). PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P19 and PAPER:BREAST_CDK_P17 both characterise heterobifunctional cereblon-recruiting molecules with DC50, ternary-complex and washout data - degradation is the paper. Fulvestrant/elacestrant docs are graded 1-2 by how much of the doc turns on receptor removal rather than antagonism. GRANT:LUNG_EGFR_G01 is a deliberate 0: allosteric occupancy chemistry for the same alleles, not removal.

Parent (dual-targeting immunoglobulins in lung, all lexically silent - they say 'dual-targeting immunoglobulin' or 'immunoglobulin engaging the ectodomain and MET') plus the T-cell-engager child in heme. LUNG_EGFR_P09 is a 3: amivantamab, an EGFR/MET bispecific, is the sole intervention. IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_G08 earns 2 for its CD3-engaging bispecific bypass arm. Zeros separate two co-administered monoclonals (BREAST_CDK_P22) and an antibody-drug conjugate (BREAST_CDK_P10) from a true bispecific.

Parent (heme target-negative relapse) plus the antigen-presentation-defect child (immuno HLA/B2M loss). HEME_CART_P01 is definitive - 22 of 41 relapses target-negative with splice, truncating and lineage-switch routes resolved. BREAST_CDK_P13 is graded 3 despite living in another subdomain and never using the phrase: surface HER2 falls 3.8-fold under conjugate pressure by outgrowth of pre-existing low-expressing cells, which is antigen escape in substance. LUNG_EGFR_P17 is 0 - antigen density simply did not predict response.

Eight of ten parent-descriptor docs and all ten child (CD8 exhaustion) docs never contain the word 'exhaustion'; they say TOX-high, ENTPD1/HAVCR2/LAG3, 'dysfunctional', 'functionally inert'. HEME_CART_P04 is the top doc: paired transcriptome and chromatin tracking of engineered T cells into a TOX-high TCF7-low state with an identified commitment window. LUNG_EGFR_P06 carries it peripherally (stromal CD8 with high TOX/PDCD1). BREAST_CDK_P08 is 0 - CD8 cells expand and stay functional there.

Parent (lung) with MMR-deficiency (immuno) and RB1-pathway (breast) children - three subdomains for one concept. LUNG_EGFR_P07 is definitive: biallelic RB1 plus TP53 inactivation at baseline is the exposure, the risk factor and the conclusion. IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P02 is a deliberate 0 - B2M biallelic inactivation is loss of an antigen-presentation component, not of a tumour suppressor, and is the most tempting near-miss in the corpus for this query. IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P19 is graded 1 rather than 0 because it does carry the mismatch-repair child descriptor, but only as a note that deficient specimens sit above every measurement threshold.

Parent (breast PK) with CNS-penetration (lung) and exposure-response (immuno) children. LUNG_EGFR_P16 is the clearest 3: unbound partitioning measured for nine agents by microdialysis with equilibrium-dialysis correction, showing total-drug ratios misrank five of nine. BREAST_CDK_P18 and IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P20 are population PK models with explicit exposure-response analyses. BREAST_CDK_P23 is 0 - it measures oestrone concentrations as a pharmacodynamic correlate, with no drug exposure modelling.

query: racial and socioeconomic disparities in cancer care
notes: Parent (lung) with access-disparity child (heme). BREAST_CDK_P21 is graded 3 although it sits in a third subdomain and never says 'disparity': it measures Medicaid/uninsured status, non-English language, distance to pharmacy and out-of-pocket cost against adherence in a safety-net system. IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P19 earns 2 for showing ancestry-dependent inflation of TMB estimates that pushes one group across an access threshold. IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_G05 is a 0: its equity claim is about autoimmune comorbidity exclusion, not racial or socioeconomic disparity.

Parent (breast peri-operative systemic therapy) with neoadjuvant-immunotherapy child (immuno), plus LUNG_EGFR_P22, an adjuvant osimertinib trial that carries the concept under a different descriptor. BREAST_CDK_P14 is the definitive doc - five-year invasive disease-free survival of two years of adjuvant abemaciclib. HEME_CART_P12 is a 0: myeloma maintenance therapy is a tempting lexical neighbour but is given for measurable disease, not after curative-intent local therapy.

Eight of nine parent docs are lexically silent - they describe TREM2/APOE/SPP1 lipid-handling macrophage states rather than 'immunosuppression'. IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P04 is the strongest evidence doc (depleting anti-TREM2 restores anti-PD-1 sensitivity; Fc-silent variant does nothing), so 3. LUNG_EGFR_P18 is 2 for CD163-high TGFB1-high macrophages in EGFR-mutant tumours. HEME_CART_G04 and P07 are graded 1, not 0: the vocabulary places monocyte-driven inflammation under this parent, but in those documents the myeloid programme drives neurotoxicity rather than suppression of antitumour immunity. The zeros are suppression without a myeloid source (stromal TGF-beta) and a T-cell-only account of the same tumours.

Nine of eleven parent docs never say 'cell cycle'; they talk about the restriction point, RB1 serine-780/807 occupancy, E2F output and MCM2 chromatin loading. BREAST_CDK_P03 is the definitive doc - an eleven-gene E2F output score outperforms RB1 status for predicting CDK4/6 sensitivity across 58 lines and 14 xenografts. Lung docs reporting CCNE1 amplification and CDKN2A loss at progression are graded 1 (peripheral, cross-subdomain). HEME_CART_P21 is 0: marrow recovery kinetics is not cell cycle control.

Parent with two children (residual disease in heme, pathologic response in immuno). HEME_CART_P12 is the definitive doc: trial-level R-squared of 0.72 between treatment effects on undetectable disease and on progression-free survival across 14 randomised trials, with a surrogate threshold effect. BREAST_CDK_P22 earns 2 for using pathologic complete response as the primary non-inferiority endpoint with event-free survival as the anchor. IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P18 is 0 - it validates an assay and explicitly uses no outcome data.

Parent (heme chromatin work) with the reprogramming child (lung persistence and lineage plasticity), plus breast single-nucleus ATAC docs that carry the concept under other descriptors. LUNG_EGFR_P08 is definitive: loss of H3K27 trimethylation across a 340-enhancer ASCL1 domain precedes morphologic change by four weeks and is pharmacologically modifiable only in that window. HEME_CART_G05 is a pointed 0 - CRISPR editing changes the genome, not its regulation, and is the most likely false positive for a keyword retriever here.

The only query in this set with grade-3 documents in all four subdomain files, and most of them never use the parent's wording. IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P18 partitions variance across four PD-L1 assays, three laboratories and 28 pathologists and states outright that it uses no outcome data; LUNG_EGFR_P04 and BREAST_CDK_P09 are the same study design applied to MET copy number and to HER2-low scoring, and HEME_CART_P19/P11 to residual-disease platforms. IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P20 is 0 - model qualification is not assay concordance.

Six of seven parent docs are lexically silent - they say 'rerouted the same signal through a second receptor' or 'adaptive receptor reactivation'. GRANT:LUNG_EGFR_G02 is definitive: amplified MET restoring ERBB3, PI3K and ERK output while EGFR stays inhibited, with the whole project anchoring the amplification threshold to signalling output. The PI3K child pulls in breast docs (BREAST_CDK_G05/P11). LUNG_EGFR_P01 is a deliberate 0: C797S is on-target escape at the same receptor, the classic contrast case for this concept.

LUNG_EGFR_P10 is the definitive doc: four insertion-bearing kinase domains solved at 2.1-2.6 angstrom, pocket volume computed, and a compound designed against the contracted back pocket with 38-fold wild-type sparing. The degrader child brings in BREAST_CDK_G12, which selects ligase-recruiting ligands by ternary-complex surfaces distant from the ATP pocket. HEME_CART_G11 is 1 - epitope/binder co-engineering verified by surface plasmon resonance is structure-guided but not small-molecule design.

Parent/child pair that splits cleanly across lung and breast, with heme (HEME_CART_P23, 1:1 randomised dosing interval) and immuno grants judged as well. LUNG_EGFR_P22 is a double-blind 1:1 randomisation of 682 patients with a pre-specified primary endpoint - the prototypical instance. The two zeros are the discriminating cases: single-arm phase 2 studies with historical or Simon two-stage comparators (HEME_CART_P08, BREAST_CDK_P19), which share almost all trial vocabulary but are not randomised.

Four of five parent docs never use the word 'plasticity'. LUNG_EGFR_P08 is definitive - lineage tracing proves converted neuroendocrine tumours descend from alveolar type 2 cells rather than a pre-existing population. HEME_CART_P01 is graded 3 from another subdomain: three relapses switched to a myeloid immunophenotype while retaining the leukaemic immunoglobulin rearrangement, which is the same biology in a different tissue. BREAST_CDK_P13 is 0 - selection of a pre-existing low-antigen subpopulation is not a change of lineage identity.

GRANT:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_G10 is definitive: the whole proposal is whether anti-CTLA-4 works by blockade or by Fc-gamma-receptor-dependent elimination of intratumoral FOXP3 cells, with a randomised attenuated-dose arm. The regulatory-T-cell-depletion child pulls in two breast docs that are lexically silent for CTLA-4 but report preferential suppression of regulatory T cell proliferation raising the effector-to-regulatory ratio (graded 1, peripheral - the mechanism is CDK4/6 inhibition, not CTLA-4). Zeros are PD-1-only studies.

IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P01 is the definitive doc: JAK1/JAK2 loss-of-function at progression abolishes class I induction and CXCL9 secretion after cytokine exposure, with autologous killing falling from 61 to 9 percent. LUNG_EGFR_P18 is graded 2 from another subdomain because restoring the pathway with a constitutively active STAT1 allele raises class I 5.1-fold and confers PD-1 sensitivity. Breast docs reporting type III (not gamma) interferon induction are graded 1 - adjacent but a different ligand family.

All twelve descriptor-bearing documents are lexically silent - not one contains the phrase 'oncogene addiction'; they say 'the tumour remains entirely dependent on the same receptor', 'exquisitely sensitive to kinase inhibition', 'driver-dependent'. GRANT:LUNG_EGFR_G01 states the concept most directly. The four narrower children (ALK, ROS1, exon 20, KRAS G12C) are judged alongside the parent. Zeros are the two most tempting near-misses: therapies addressed to a surface antigen rather than to a driver dependency.

Every descriptor-bearing document is lexically silent for 'hypoxia': they say oxygen deprivation, poorly perfused regions, pimonidazole labelling, stabilised HIF1A, interstitial pH. IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P16 is definitive - mass spectrometry imaging shows adenosine 4.6-fold enriched in pimonidazole-labelled regions with granzyme B falling 26 percent per 100 micrometres into the labelled zone, and oxygen tension measured directly by fibre-optic probe. HEME_CART_G07/P14 are cross-subdomain 2s: hypoxia-responsive expression cassettes built for sub-1-percent oxygen tumour beds.

Six of seven descriptor-bearing docs never use 'persister' or 'drug-tolerant'. LUNG_EGFR_P05 is definitive: a 0.6-4 percent residual fraction that acquires no kinase-domain variant, reverts to parental IC50 within 21 days of withdrawal, and dies on GPX4 inactivation with full ferrostatin rescue. BREAST_CDK_P07 and G06 are graded 2 from another subdomain - a persistent non-dividing reservoir that survives continuous drug and reseeds regrowth, described as senescence rather than tolerance. Zeros are genetically encoded escape, the opposite case.

query: stem-like progenitor exhausted CD8 T cells
notes: IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P14 is definitive - fate mapping shows 91 percent of post-treatment proliferation derives from the TCF7-positive SLAMF6-positive subset, which is where tumour-reactive clones sat before treatment. HEME_CART_P03 is graded 3 across subdomains: the same cell state (TCF7, IL7R, SELL, CD27, low ENTPD1) measured in CAR T infusion products, where clonotype tracking shows expanding clones derive from it 4.1-fold preferentially. Neither doc uses the query's vocabulary.

PAPER:HEME_CART_P09 is definitive: TRAC and B2M disrupted specifically to prevent donor T cells attacking host tissue, with no grade 2 or higher acute graft-versus-host disease as a reported outcome. HEME_CART_P10 covers the reciprocal half of alloreactivity - host natural killer clearance of the class-I-null graft, restrained by an HLA-E trimer knock-in. Zeros are immune-mediated tissue injury of other kinds (drug-induced pneumonitis, checkpoint colitis) that share the inflammatory vocabulary but involve no allogeneic mismatch.

Six of seven descriptor-bearing docs are lexically silent, describing 'four or more independent alterations per patient', 'fragmented escape' or 'the average of a mixture'. LUNG_EGFR_P14 is definitive - a median of two and up to three or more independent alterations per patient at progression, with survival tracking the count. GRANT:BREAST_CDK_G11 is a cross-subdomain 3 built on the same premise from the transcriptional side: bulk sequencing reports the average of a mixture and misses states carried by a minority of cells.

query: solid tumor barriers to CAR T-cell therapy
notes: Parent with a trafficking child; HEME_CART_P14 is the definitive doc because intravital imaging localises the gain to extravasation specifically, separating entry from adhesion, and pairs receptor matching with a hypoxia-restricted payload. HEME_CART_P13 supplies the suppression half (dominant-negative TGFBR2 raising intratumoral density from 41 to 184 cells per square millimetre). LUNG_EGFR_P18 is a pointed 0: it is about T-cell exclusion in a solid tumour, but no engineered cell therapy is involved.

BREAST_CDK_P07 is definitive: 58-74 percent of arrested cells acquire beta-galactosidase activity, p21 induction and an IL-6/CXCL8 secretory programme persisting past day 60, and a CRISPR screen run in already-arrested cells identifies BCL2L1 as the survival dependency. LUNG_EGFR_P06 is a cross-subdomain 1 - its diapause-like quiescent programme with low MKI67 and elevated CDKN1A is adjacent but is never characterised as senescence. BREAST_CDK_P03 is 0: same drug, same pathway, no arrest-phenotype measurement.

HEME_CART_P21 is definitive - pre-conditioning marrow sequencing in 388 patients, clonal hematopoiesis in 39 percent, and formal mediation showing PPM1D and TP53 variants rather than inflammation explain prolonged cytopenia. Three immuno documents are graded 1 because they treat clonal hematopoiesis purely as a variant class to be filtered out of mutational burden estimates - a real but wholly peripheral appearance. BREAST_CDK_P23 is 0: inherited germline variation is not somatic clonal expansion.

query: histologic transformation to small cell carcinoma
notes: LUNG_EGFR_P07 is definitive: 388 patients with baseline sequencing and progression biopsies, central pathology review requiring compatible morphology plus two neuroendocrine markers with the founding EGFR allele retained, and a 27-fold relative risk conferred by biallelic RB1 plus TP53 loss. HEME_CART_P01 is a cross-subdomain 1 - lineage switch to a myeloid immunophenotype is the same category of event in a different tissue, but not small cell carcinoma. LUNG_EGFR_P05 is 0: a reversible non-genetic survival state with no morphologic change.

BREAST_CDK_P21 is definitive - medication possession ratio, prior-authorisation delay and out-of-pocket cost modelled against non-adherence and time to discontinuation. GRANT:BREAST_CDK_G09 embeds a second randomisation whose endpoint is the proportion completing 24 months at intended dose intensity. LUNG_EGFR_P23 and P21 are cross-subdomain 2s (relative dose intensity 94 vs 81 percent; time to treatment discontinuation). IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P21 is 0 - it models payer cost, never whether patients take or stay on the drug.
